concepts.gloss_en: his words are heard/heeded by the creatures (the world at large) — tied to the LM1:5 context of gevurot producing thunder and voices heard from above
one's words are heeded/accepted by one's fellow — condition attained through fear of Heaven when speaking with a companion (LM2:7)

members.note: representative; distinct usage — words heeded by a specific fellow, not the world; no 'לבריתא' qualifier and different Torah/context

notes: Token overlap on 'דבריו נשמעין' only. The two usages have different referents: LM1:5 speaks of words heard by 'בריתא' (the creatures/world) in the thunder-gevurot motif, while LM2:7 speaks of words being heeded specifically by one's fellow (אצל חברו). Under-merge: kept separate.
